title: HCCL/HCOMM API adaptation on hcomm-fix-api
content: Added a dedicated hccl_config.h to surface the shared enum definitions (HcclOpExpansionMode, HcclConfigType) and the HcclConfigGetInfo prototype so both the public include tree and hccl_comm_dlsym adaptors see the same API surface. Updated the dynamic loader headers to rely on the new config file, aligned the hcomm primitives stub signatures (MsgHandle -> uint64_t) and cc execution helpers (HcclConfigGetInfo reference) and refreshed the hccl stub to bind callbacks through the new handle. These tweaks mirror the hcomm-api-fix branch hits on the include tree while keeping our wrappers and stubs compiling against the reshaped HCOMM headers.
